description: This file defines a WebDriverFactory class that creates WebDriver instances based on configuration, supporting different browsers and modes (discovery-only or real). It encapsulates logic for initializing Chrome and Firefox drivers with specific options.

classes.name: WebDriverFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating WebDriver instances based on configuration, supporting Chrome, Firefox, and discovery mode.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a WebDriver instance based on the provided configuration, supporting discovery-only mode, Chrome, and Firefox with optional headless configuration.
